fields.title: Local guides
fields.text: Every route is led by a guide from the region it crosses.

fields.title: Small groups
fields.text: Group sizes are listed on each trip page so you know what to expect.

fields.title: Clear pricing
fields.text: Prices are per person in US dollars, shown on every trip page.

fields.title: Talk to a person
fields.text: Ask a question or design a custom trip and we reply directly.

fields.title: Leave no trace
fields.text: Carry out what you carry in, and use refill points where available.

fields.title: Stay and eat locally
fields.text: Teahouses and village shops keep trekking income in the communities on the trail.

fields.title: Respect the people who carry
fields.text: Porter loads and working conditions matter. Edit this line to describe your own policy.

fields.title: Stay on the trail
fields.text: Keep to marked paths and follow park rules to protect fragile mountain ground.
